progressQueryReview.paidPollingForbidden: Do not add inference only to ask whether a known pending physical operation has finished.
progressQueryReview.existingGate: Automatic investigator may wait on authentic matched physical progress; unknown or changed sources, new needs, manual requests and repair stay investigable.
progressQueryReview.receiptScope: A pure receiving-team confirmation is reconciled only against a unique independently received physical receipt matching building, quantity, type and times. The public post stays unverified. Extra demand/hazard wording or ambiguity prevents skipping.
progressQueryReview.facilityRefresh: A new authentic provision receipt newer than site status allows one targeted current facility status query; it cannot be counted as stock remaining or safety certification. Pending owner workflows do not spawn duplicate activation/provision plans.
